sentences.en: Discontinuing duloxetine, especially when done abruptly, commonly leads to withdrawal effects.
sentences.zh: 突然停用文拉法辛通常会导致戒断症状。

sentences.en: Due to a technical malfunction, this train's service will be henceforth discontinued.
sentences.zh: 由于技术故障，此列车的服务将从此不再提供。

sentences.en: It's important not to change or discontinue medication without seeking medical advice.
sentences.zh: 未经医生建议，请勿随意更改或停止服用药物。
